rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: At realization, the Book is undeniably true; alternatively, it is the all-encompassing truth that clarifies the Book promised by earlier prophets and scriptures, known in prior knowledge and promised in the Torah and Gospel with Muhammad.
rows.anchor: عند التحقيق بأنه الحق، وعلى تقدير القول معناه بالحق الذي هو الكل من حيث هو كل لأنه مبين لذلك الكتاب الموعود

rows.speaker: عيسى عليه السلام
rows.claim: Qashani reports Jesus saying that the revelation will come through them, while its interpretation will come with the Mahdi at the end of time.
rows.anchor: وأما التأويل فسيأتي به المهدي في آخر الزمان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The answer to an oath is omitted because ذلك الكتاب indicates it, as in other Quranic passages beginning with oaths by the sun or those who pull out souls.
rows.anchor: وحذف جواب القسم لدلالة ذلك الكتاب عليه، كما حذف في غير موضع من القرآن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Book is itself guidance for those who avoid vices and the veils that prevent them from accepting its truth.
rows.anchor: هدى في نفسه للذين يتقون الرذائل والحجب المانعة لقبول الحق فيه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People fall into seven final classes: the wretched and the happy; the happy comprise the people of the right and the foremost brought near.
rows.anchor: إما سعداء، وإما أشقياء. قال الله تعالى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One group of the left is eternally cast out, totally veiled and sealed in heart without primordial readiness for guidance.
rows.anchor: المطرودون الذين حق عليهم القول وهم أهل الظلمة والحجاب الكلي المختوم على قلوبهم أزلا

rows.speaker: الحديث الرباني
rows.claim: A divine report says that God created a group for the Fire without concern for them.
rows.anchor: هؤلاء خلقتهم للنار ولا أبالي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Hypocrites had innate readiness but acquired a veil through vice, sins, animal and predatory conduct, and satanic schemes; their dark dispositions make them doubtful and lost, with a worse state than the unready because their original potential conflicts with their condition.
rows.anchor: احتجبت قلوبهم بالرين المستفاد من اكتساب الرذائل وارتكاب المعاصي، ومباشرة الأعمال البهيمية، والسبعية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People of virtue believe and do good seeking and desiring Paradise; they find their deeds present there, with ranks varying according to their works.
rows.anchor: الذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات للجنة راجين لها، راضين بها، فوجدوا ما عملوا حاضرا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People of mercy keep sound souls and clear hearts, receiving garden ranks by their capacities through divine bounty rather than earned perfection.
rows.anchor: الباقون على سلامة نفوسهم، وصفاء قلوبهم، المتبوئون درجات الجنة على حسب استعداداتهم من فضل ربهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Among those who mix good and bad, some are pardoned outright because conviction is strong, sins are shallow, or they have repented; God changes their misdeeds into good deeds.
rows.anchor: المعفو عنهم رأسا لقوة اعتقادهم، وعدم رسوخ سيئاتهم لقلة مزاولتهم إياها، أو لمكان توبتهم عنها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Others are punished temporarily until entrenched sins are cleansed, then saved; they are people of justice and punishment, and mercy eventually reaches them.
rows.anchor: المعذبون حينا بحسب ما رسخ فيهم من المعاصي حتى خلصوا عن درن ما كسبوا، فنجوا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The foremost are either lovers who strive and turn back to God, or beloved people chosen through primordial divine care and guided to a straight path.
rows.anchor: والسابقون إما محبون وإما محبوبون، فالمحبون هم الذين جاهدوا في الله حق جهاده

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Lovers who strive sincerely and return to God are guided to His paths.
rows.anchor: أنابوا إليه حق إنابته، فهداهم سبله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The beloved are people of primordial care whom God selects and guides to a straight path.
rows.anchor: أهل العناية الأزلية الذين اجتباهم وهداهم إلى صراط مستقيم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Quran cannot guide the two first, damned groups because one lacks readiness and the other has lost it; it guides the last five classes, all included among the God-fearing.
rows.anchor: فالقرآن ليس هدى للفريق الأول من الأشقياء لامتناع قبولهم للهداية لعدم استعدادهم، ولا للثاني لزوال استعدادهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The beloved still need scripture after attraction and arrival to continue journeying in God, while lovers need it before and after arrival for the journey to and in God.
rows.anchor: والمحبوب يحتاج إلى هداية الكتاب بعد الجذب والوصول لسلوكه في الله لقوله تعالى لحبيبه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: After describing the happy and wretched, Qashani says the address calls people to divine unity.
rows.anchor: لما فرغ من ذكر السعداء والأشقياء، دعاهم إلى التوحيد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The first level of unity is unity of acts; tying worship to lordship lets people see blessings and love God, as the saying describes God creating creatures and making Himself beloved through blessings.
rows.anchor: توحيد الأفعال، فلهذا علق العبودية بالربوبية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Worship is gratitude for a bestowed blessing, and God specifies His lordship over people so they will specify their worship for Him.
rows.anchor: إذ العبادة شكر فلا تكون إلا في مقابلة النعمة، وخصص ربوبيته بهم ليخصوا عبادتهم به

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Creation, its prerequisites, the earth, sky, rain, and plants are attributed to God so people recognize all acts as His and lift the first veil, the veil of acts.
rows.anchor: نسب إنشاءهم وإنشاء ما توقف عليه وجودهم من المبادئ والأسباب والشرائط كمن قبلهم من الآباء والأمهات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The listed acts establish that only their maker deserves worship; knowingly attributing an act to another makes that other seem a rival worthy of worship.
rows.anchor: هو الذي فعل هذه الأفعال، فلا تحق العبادة إلا له، ولا تنبغي أن تجعل لغيره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Worshippers worship the maker, whose manifestation appears in created form; each knows God only to the extent of the divinity found within, and these people found only the voluntary agent.
rows.anchor: وربهم هو المتجلي في صورة الصنع، إذ كل عابد لا يعبد إلا ما يعرفه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In the inward analogy, souls are earth, spirits are sky, knowledge of unity of acts is rain, and surrender, obedience, good works, and virtues are the resulting growth that yields certainties, states, and stations such as patience, gratitude, and reliance.
rows.anchor: مهد لهم أراضي نفوسهم، وبنى عليها سموات أرواحهم، وأنزل من تلك السموات ماء علم توحيد الأفعال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Islam requires both testimonies: unity alone hides differentiation and becomes determinism leading to heresy and antinomianism, while attributing acts only to the Messenger hides unity and becomes dualism; Islam joins both and regards the Messenger as the manifestation of divine acts.
rows.anchor: بين قولنا: لا إله إلا الله، وبين قولنا: محمد رسول الله، واعتقاد مظهريته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Created acts relate to divine acts as body to spirit: spirit is their source but acts through the body, just as God originates acts that appear through creatures.
rows.anchor: فكما أن مصدر الفعل هو الروح ولا يتم إلا بالجسد، فكذلك مبدئ الفعل هو الحق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A messenger is necessary because veiled, distant creatures cannot receive divine knowledge directly; a mediator combines a spirit witnessing the divine presence with a human nature among people, receives divine words, and conveys them to people who accept him through shared nature.
rows.anchor: فيجب وجود واسطة يجانس بروحه الشاهدة للحق الحضرة الإلهية، وبنفسه المخالطة للخلق الرتبة البشرية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Messenger receives the divine words in his heart and conveys them through his purified self to humankind.
rows.anchor: ليتلقى قلبه من روحه الكلمات الربانية، ويلقي إلى نفسه القدسية، ويقبل منه الخلق

words: وقالت اليهود ليست النصارى على شيء
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Jews and Christians reject one another because each is veiled by its own religion; Qashani compares this to present day Muslim schools, with Jews veiled by outward form and Christians by inward meaning.
rows.anchor: لاحتجابهم بدينهم عن دينهم، وكذا قالت النصارى لاحتجابهم بالباطن عن الظاهر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their scriptures guide them to lift veils and recognize truth in other religions and schools; adherents are not thereby false, and unlearned polytheists are more excusable because reason alone binds them, whereas scriptural communities have reason and revelation.
rows.anchor: وفيه ما يرشدهم إلى رفع الحجاب، ورؤية حق كل دين ومذهب، وليس أهل ذلك الدين والمذهب حقهم بباطل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God judges their disputes at the great Resurrection and the manifestation of essential unity at the Mahdi's emergence; a report says people recognize God in forms of their beliefs, then deny Him when He changes form, leaving only the unconditioned monotheist unveiled.
rows.anchor: إن الله يتجلى لعباده في صورة معتقداتهم فيعرفونه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The mosques are hearts, the places where God is known and worshipped through annihilation of the self in the divine essence; the Greatest Name manifests there with all attributes, or a particular name manifests the perfection suited to each heart's capacity.
rows.anchor: مواضع سجود الله التي هي القلوب التي يعرف فيها فيسجد بالفناء الذاتي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The special divine name is the Greatest Name, whose manifestation is the essence with all attributes, or the particular name and perfection required by the heart's preparedness.
rows.anchor: لا يتجلى بهذا الاسم إلا في القلب، وهو التجلي بالذات مع جميع الصفات أو اسمه المخصوص بكل واحد منها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ruining hearts means clouding them with cold fanaticism and overpowering desires, and barring prepared people through turmoil and conflict among soul powers, satanic promptings, and illusion.
rows.anchor: بتكديرها بالتعصبات الباردة وغلبة واستيلاء التمنيات عليها، ومنع أهلها المستعدين عنها بالهرج والمرج

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who enter the hearts should come humbled and broken before the manifest theophany of the Real.
rows.anchor: منكسرين لظهور تجلي الحق فيها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their worldly disgrace is exposure and humiliation as their religion and belief are invalidated by the true religion and they are defeated and regretful.
rows.anchor: افتضاح وذلة بظهور بطلان دينهم ومعتقدهم، وفسخه بدين الحق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their great afterlife punishment is being veiled from God by their religion.
rows.anchor: هو الاحتجاب عن الحق بدينهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet turns toward the sky of spirit in the station of unity, absorbed in oneness and veiled from creation; the burdens of prophecy and calling make return to people difficult before he is firmly established in subsistence after annihilation.
rows.anchor: في جهة سماء الروح في مقام الجمع عند الاستغراق في الوحدة والاحتجاب بالحق عن الخلق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The desired qibla is the heart's direction through an opened breast: unity there appears in differentiated form without being obscured by multiplicity, enabling the Prophet to invite people while retaining the witness of unity.
rows.anchor: فلنجعلن وجهك يلي قبلة القلب بانشراح الصدر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Sacred Mosque signifies the side of the opened chest, protected from the qualities of the lower self and the promptings of desire and Satan.
rows.anchor: جانب الصدر المشروح المحرم من وصول صفات النفس، ودواعي الهوى والشيطان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Believers and knowers turn toward that side whether in the east of spirit or west of soul: in the former it eases enjoining right and forbidding wrong; in the latter it enables ascent and protection from desire and satanic veiling.
rows.anchor: أيها المؤمنون والمحققون، سواء كنتم في جهة مشرق الروح ومغرب النفس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The given books include Torah, Gospel, and the discriminating book of acquired intellect; their guidance shows unity of acts and attributes and points to Muhammad's essential unity.
rows.anchor: التوراة والإنجيل وكتاب العقل الفرقاني

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They can also know the truth through intellect illuminated by revealed light, rather than intellect veiled by speculative analogy.
rows.anchor: أو بنور العقل المنور بالنور الشرعي لا المحجوب بالقياس الفكري

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They see calamities as God's continual disposal of them and witness the effects of His power and the lights of His attributes' manifestations.
rows.anchor: من تصرفاتي فيهم دائما شاهدوا آثار قدرتي، بل أنوار تجليات صفتي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Saying that they belong to God means surrendering and knowing that they are His property, subject to His disposal.
rows.anchor: سلموا وأيقنوا أنهم ملكي، أتصرف فيه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Returning to God means effacing themselves in Him and witnessing their annihilation in Him.
rows.anchor: تفانوا في، وشاهدوا تهلكهم في بي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Lord's blessings are gifted existence after annihilation, existence characterized by His attributes and illuminated by His lights.
rows.anchor: بالوجود الموهوب لهم بعد الفناء الموصوف بصفاتي المنور بأنواري

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Mercy is light and guidance through which they guide creation to God.
rows.anchor: نور وهداية يهدون بها الخلق إلي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Qashani cites a supplication asking God to make the speakers guides and guided, neither astray nor leading others astray.
rows.anchor: واجعلنا هادين مهديين غير ضالين ولا مضلين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Safa and Marwa signify the purity of the heart's existence and the existence of the lower self; their inward rites include certainty, contentment, sincerity, and reliance, while outward rites include prayer, fasting, and bodily worship.
rows.anchor: صفاء وجود القلب ومروة وجود النفس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Pilgrimage means attaining essential unity and entering the divine presence through total annihilation in the essence; lesser pilgrimage means entering the presence through unity of attributes and annihilation in the manifestations of beauty and majesty.
rows.anchor: نار الحضرة بتوحيد الصفات والفناء في أنوار تجليات الجمال والجلال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: There is no blame in returning between heart and soul after annihilation when one is established in gifted existence; unlike acquired selfhood, this state is spacious.
rows.anchor: يرجع إلى مقامهما، ويتردد بينهما، لا بوجودهما التكويني، فإنه جناح وذنب، بل بالوجود الموهوب بعد الفناء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Voluntary good includes teaching, compassion, counsel, love of the righteous, moral virtue, helping the weak and poor, and showing care for them and one's family after spiritual journeying and subsistence.
rows.anchor: من باب التعاليم وشفقة الخلق والنصيحة ومحبة أهل الخير والصلاح بوجود القلب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God is thankful by granting increased reward and knows that this work proceeds through acting in things by God, not creation, trial, or interruption.
rows.anchor: يشكر عمله بثواب المزيد { عليم } بأنه من

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who fight believers are the devil and the commanding soul's powers.
rows.anchor: من الشيطان وقوى النفس الأمارة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Do not destroy the lower self so completely that it can no longer fulfill its rights and limits and falls into neglect or weakness; transgression leaves the just shadow of divine love and unity.
rows.anchor: بأن تميتوها عن قيامها بحقوقها والوقوف على حدودها حتى تقع في التفريط والقصور

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Killing them means suppressing the lower self's desire and preventing its actions wherever it appears.
rows.anchor: أزيلوا حياتهم وامنعوهم عن أفعالها بقمع هواها الذي هو روحها حيث كانوا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Expelling them from Mecca means reclaiming the chest after the lower self takes it over, just as it had dragged the seeker from the heart's home into the realm of the self.
rows.anchor: من مكة الصدر عند استيلائها عليها كما أخرجوكم عنها باستنزالكم إلى بقعة النفس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Worshipping desire and its pleasure idols, or enduring its domination, is worse than suppressing it; total killing would erase innate traits and preparedness, causing greater pain.
rows.anchor: فتنتهم التي هي عبادة هواها وأصنام لذاتها أشد من قمع هواها وإماتتها الكلية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Sacred Mosque is the heart's station; when the soul's powers align with the seeker's orientation there, they assist the spiritual journey, so fighting begins only if they challenge it and pull the seeker back to the lower self.
rows.anchor: عند الحضور القلبي إذا وافقوكم في توجهكم فإنها أعوانكم على السلوك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Struggle continues until conflict and the soul's promptings cease and all faculties turn toward the sacred presence with the inner secret, leaving no share for Satan or desire; if they stop, only transgressors may be opposed.
rows.anchor: بتوجيه جميعها إلى جناب القدس ومشايعتها للسر في التوجه إلى الحق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Qashani quotes a saying: give sinners glad tidings that God forgives, and warn the righteous that God forgives.
rows.anchor: بشر المذنبين بأني غفور وأنذر الصديقين بأني غفور

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The person whose speech pleases claims love while being a fierce opponent, since he remains in the lower self and heresy; he speaks only in worldly life, not from the heart in the afterlife.
rows.anchor: يدعي المحبة وهو ألد الخصام لكونه في مقام النفس زنديقا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When he turns away, he spreads corruption through permissiveness and heresy, as Qashani says is seen among many claimants to love and unity.
rows.anchor: لإباحته وتزندقه كما ترى عليه أكثر مدعي المحبة والتوحيد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: His claim to love God is false: a lover does what the beloved loves, but God does not love his corrupt actions; Qashani supports the point with an unnamed poet's couplet about disobedience contradicting love.
rows.anchor: وكيف تتأتى له والمحب لا يفعل إلا ما يحب محبوبه، والله لا يحب ما يفعله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Egoistic zeal rooted in pre-Islamic arrogance drives him stubbornly into sin, as his self asserts itself and he assumes he knows better than his adviser.
rows.anchor: حملته الحمية النفسانية حمية الجاهلية على الإثم لجاجا وأشرا لظهور نفسه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Jahannam is the ultimate depth and darkness of his low spiritual rank; Qashani explains its name as a deep, dark pit.
rows.anchor: فإن جهنم معناه: مهوى بعيد العمق مظلمة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The person who sells himself gives himself over to the path of God in search of His pleasure.
rows.anchor: يبذل نفسه في سلوك سبيل الله طلبا لرضاه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Entering peace means surrendering and submitting one's whole self to God; conflict among the faculties and their refusal to submit together show that they follow Satan.
rows.anchor: في الاستسلام وتسليم الوجوه لله، إذ معاداة القوى بعضها بعضا، وعدم موافقتها في التسليم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Satan wants people to deserve divine subjugation through excesses born of hostility between his fiery nature and their innate light; he is truly an enemy appearing as a friend.
rows.anchor: لاختلاف جبلته وجبلتكم، وقصوره عن نور فطرتكم، لكونه ناري الخلقة لا يطلب منكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Messenger believes by accepting revelation and embodying its character and meanings; Aisha describes his character as the Quran and its ascent toward realization.
rows.anchor: صدقه بقبوله والتخلق به، كما قالت

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The believers witness God's unity in the differentiated forms of Himself, angels, books, and messengers, assigning each manifestation its proper locus and rule.
rows.anchor: مشاهدا لوحدته في صورة تلك الكثرة معطيا لكل تجل من تجلياته في مظهر من مظاهره وحكمه

words: لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِّن رُّسُلِهِ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They reject none of the messengers or their truth, because they witness unity and see the Real in them through the Real.
rows.anchor: لا نفرق بينهم برد بعض وقبول بعض، ولا نشك في كونهم على الحق وبالحق لشهود التوحيد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Saying that they hear means answering God through His books and messengers and the descent of angels, and remaining upright in their spiritual journey.
rows.anchor: أجبنا ربنا في كتبه ورسله ونزول ملائكته واستقمنا في سيرنا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Asking forgiveness means asking God to erase their separate existences and attributes through His existence and attributes.
rows.anchor: اغفر لنا وجوداتنا وصفاتنا وامحها بوجودك ووجود صفاتك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their final return is annihilation in God.
rows.anchor: بالفناء فيك

words: لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God assigns each self only the unveilings and manifestations its vessel can bear, according to primordial preparedness granted through the holiest effusion.
rows.anchor: حظ كل أحد من الكشوف والتجليات ما يطيق به وعاء استعداده الموهوب له في الأزل

words: لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا اكْتَسَبَتْ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Good works, knowledge, perfections, and unveilings belong to the self, intentionally acquired or not, as goods are native to its luminous essence; dark ignorance, vice, and sin are alien and incur liability only when deliberately pursued.
rows.anchor: فإنها من عالم النور فالخيرات كلها ذاتية لها، ترجع فائدتها إليها دون الشرور من الجهالات والرذائل والمعاصي

words: لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا اكْتَسَبَتْ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A report says the angel on the right records each good deed immediately, while the angel on the left waits six hours; repentance, seeking forgiveness, or remorse prevents recording the sin.
rows.anchor: إن صاحب اليمين يكتب كل حسنة تصدر عن صاحبها في الحال

words: لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا اكْتَسَبَتْ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Here nafs means the self or essence, not the lower soul; kasb marks good that is not deliberately sought, while iktisab marks evil actively pursued by the lower soul.
rows.anchor: والمراد بالنفس ها هنا الذات وإلا لكان الأمر بالعكس، فيكون حينئذ معناه لا يكلفها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Forgetting is forgetting the covenant and error is acting for other than God while veiled from Him; the prayer describes spiritual strangers far from Him, tested in darkness, with no standing of their own before Him.
rows.anchor: في العمل لما سواك، والقران على فراقك محتجبين عنك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The burden is their own essences, attributes, and acts, which bind and exile them from God; no weight is heavier.
rows.anchor: في ذاتنا وصفاتنا وأفعالنا، فتأصرنا وتحبسنا في مكاننا مهجورين عنك

words: كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Earlier peoples were veiled either by the outward realm of acts or by the inward realm of attributes.
rows.anchor: من المحتجبين بظواهر الأفعال أو بواطن الصفات

words: وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: What they cannot bear is the weight of estrangement and deprivation from divine nearness and witnessing God's beauty, behind veils of majesty.
rows.anchor: من ثقل الهجران والحرمان عن وصالك، ومشاهدة جمالك، بحجب جلالك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Pardon means overlooking bad actions and attributes, which veil them from God and deprive them of the coolness of pardon and the pleasure of divine approval.
rows.anchor: سيئات أفعالنا وصفاتنا فإنها كلها سيئات حجبتنا عنك، وحرمتنا برد عفوك ولذة رضوانك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Forgiveness is sought for the sin of separate existence, which a quoted verse of poetry calls a sin without equal.
rows.anchor: ذنوب وجوداتنا فإنها أكبر الكبائر كما قيل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Mercy means receiving gifted existence after annihilation.
rows.anchor: بالوجود الموهوب بعد الفناء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God is their patron as helper and steward of their affairs, or their master, who is bound to support His servants.
rows.anchor: ومن حق السيد أن ينصر عبيده

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The enemies are the powers and attributes of the commanding self and the armies of satanic imaginings and fancies, veiled from God and obscuring the seekers through disbelief and darkness.
rows.anchor: من قوى نفوسنا الأمارة وصفاتها، وجنود شياطين أوهامنا وخيالاتنا، المحجوبين عنك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God heard the wife of Imran's vow and knew her intention, as she affirmed by calling Him the Hearer and Knower.
rows.anchor: بنيتها كما شهدت بقولها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Parents' intentions and dispositions affect a child as food affects the body: lawful food, luminous dispositions, and sincere intentions yield a believer, truthful person, saint, or prophet; forbidden food and corrupt dispositions yield a wicked or unbelieving child, since the embryo develops from that food and is nurtured by that soul.
rows.anchor: النيات وهيئات النفس مؤثرة في نفس الولد، كما أن الأغذية مؤثرة في بدنه

rows.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
rows.claim: The Prophet says, The child is the secret of his father; Qashani connects this to Mary's truthfulness and Jesus' blessed filial descent from her truthful father.
rows.anchor: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Mary's provision may be spiritual knowledge, realities, and wisdom flowing from God; the wording that it was with her indicates divinely bestowed, ladunni provision.
rows.anchor: الرزق الروحاني من المعارف والحقائق والعلوم والحكم الفائضة عليها من عند الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In the inward reading, angels are spiritual powers and Mary is the purified soul: God selects her by freeing her from desires and purifies her of bad traits, choosing her above sensual souls marked by ugly deeds and dispositions.
rows.anchor: عن رذائل الأخلاق والصفات المذمومة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Mary's obedience means performing worship; prostration is the station of brokenness, humility, need, helplessness, and repentance, while bowing is submissive humility among the humble.
rows.anchor: أطيعي لربك بوظائف الطاعات والعبادات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The hidden news is the unseen condition of the Prophet's own being, revealed to the Prophet of the spirit.
rows.anchor: أحوال غيب وجودك { نوحيه إليك }

words: إِذْ يُلْقُونَ أَقْلَٰمَهُمْ أَيُّهُمْ يَكْفُلُ مَرْيَمَ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The spiritual and psychic powers were not in the Prophet's rank when competing for their interests and drawing lots to govern the soul, each trying to command it for its own perceived benefit.
rows.anchor: يتسابقون في سهامهم ويتبادرون في حظوظهم أيهم يدبر مريم النفس ويكفلها بحسب رأيه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their dispute takes place in the chest, the locus of conflict between spiritual and psychic powers competing for leadership before and during discipline; with God's aid, spiritual powers prevail after discipline.
rows.anchor: يتنازعون ويتجاذبون في طلب الرياسة عند ظهوره قبل الرياضة وفي حالها، إذ غلبت ملائكة القوى الروحانية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The divinely given Word is the heart, named Messiah because it wipes the soul with light.
rows.anchor: القلب موهوبا { منه اسمه المسيح } لأنه يمسحك بالنور

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The heart is eminent in worldly life because it perceives particulars and manages worldly interests soundly; outward and inward faculties obey, defer to, and honor it.
rows.anchor: لإدراكه الجزئيات وتدبير مصالح المعاش أجود وأصفى وأصوب ما يكون، فيطيعه ويذعن له

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The heart is eminent in the afterlife through its perception of universal meanings and sacred knowledge, management of return, and guidance to truth; it receives the kingdom of the spirit's heaven and honor among those near God.
rows.anchor: لإدراكه المعاني الكلية والمعارف القدسية وقيامه بتدبير المعاد والهداية إلى الحق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The heart speaks in the body's cradle and, as an elder, approaches the station of the spirit's shaykh, its light prevailing; it is among the righteous through gnosis.
rows.anchor: بالغا إلى قرب طور شيخ الروح، غالبا عليه بياض نوره
